## What this region is

The presentational layer over the lens: shortcuts, labels and ready-made rules in the field picker that still emit the real dotted path, and recognition that collapses a saved raw rule back to its named entry. It curates what the narrowing already shows; it never restricts it.

## What it exists for

- Put a friendlier entry in the root picker
- Constrain what a collection facet covers
- Recognise, check and compute facets
- Offer a ready-made rule the user can still tune
- Write a valid preset template
- Draw and write a facet's inner dropdowns
- Facet behaviour beyond the root picker

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- turn on the orders relation so users can rule on it → lens-sources-and-surfaces
- fill the tag dropdown with values that exist in the database → lens-sources-and-surfaces
- users with at least three orders over a hundred dollars → rule-builder-and-condition-tree
- strip editor ids from the rule before saving → rule-builder-and-condition-tree
- keep integration A from ever seeing integration B's rows → lens-sources-and-surfaces
